purpose: Use Codex as the control tower while assigning bounded work to external AI lanes to save Codex tokens.
rules: Do not use Codex local LLM or GPU unless the user explicitly re-enables that lane.
Give external AI compact briefs, not whole project folders.
Bring results back as JSON, Markdown, CSV, command text, or small patches.
Codex owns integration, verification, registry updates, and dashboard visibility.
